dcb1fb8a500b2bc4515e729a3696cd477b6e0c8d.summary: A breach-news article (published 2023-09-15) reproduces a statement from the ALPHV ransomware group about its attack on MGM Resorts. The group claims it kept Okta super-administrator and Azure Global Administrator access, launched ransomware against more than 100 ESXi hypervisors on September 11, and posted a data download link. The article says the group has not answered its request for clarification, so claims about LinkedIn social engineering remain unconfirmed and possibly refuted. Rumours about teenagers from the US and UK were called unproven. The group says it cannot say whether…
